name: escalate_to_human
description: Escalate the active phone call to a human agent using Twilio. Use this only when the caller needs a human or the automation cannot safely continue.

request_body_schema.description: Payload sent to Twilio when the caller needs a human. Dynamic variables identify the original Twilio parent call, and LLM-generated fields provide concise escalation context for the receiving agent.

parentCallSid.description: Original inbound Twilio Call SID to update during escalation.

handoffId.description: Correlation ID for Flex task attributes, logs, and analytics.

summary.description: Concise handoff summary for the human.
